title: RAW UNREVIEWED: whole f85 E/S returns a cool-place description to a seek directive rather than a patient diagnosis
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Over complete owned f85r2 E27 and S26, propose an ambient-condition account followed by a reader-directed search for a cool/shaded dwelling. One globally typed description constructor preserves referent domain; a later written SEEK must consume its PlaceSpec field rather than a PatientDiagnosis or achieved bodily coldness. Source: owned Laufenberg Summer advice; no word meanings, segmentation or actor bindings have been supplied.

design.author_role: bounded producer; parent owns selection; no active author artifacts inspected

unit.seed: Complete owned f85r2 E, .7–11,27groups in each reader
unit.consumer: Complete owned f85r2 S,.12–17,26groups in each reader
unit.total: Both53-group blocks with every original group/boundary and all alternate readings. N/W and .1/.24 are future debts, not claimed read or admitted afresh.
unit.ownership: Fixed E=ambient/corrective-target description; S=human reader-directed seek instruction is a PAID prospective synopsis allocation, not image evidence or source order established in Voynich.

source_prior.concrete_claim: Owned Summer body has warm/dry seasonal description, warnings, and a reader-directed instruction to move from sun to shade/a cool dwelling. Root reading of167.P01 is suche dir: seek a cool dwelling.
source_prior.independent_source_support: HIPPOCRATIC_HEAT_SOURCE_REPORT.md identifies Karlsruhe91r instructions avoiding sun, entering shade and seeking a cool dwelling; actor is distinct from the chosen environment. Both are related witnesses, not independent target confirmation.
source_prior.limits: No achieved body coldness, innate-heat equality, clinical diagnosis, medicinal liquid, numerical bearing or successful compliance. Print1491 is later than manuscript dating window. No direct source-copy claim.
source_prior.limited_synopsis: Prospectively retain ambient solar/seasonal condition, addressed person, avoidance/shade relation and desired cool dwelling. Other Summer foods, care, timings, caption and cautions remain source context and are explicitly omitted from this limited synopsis; no whole-poem equivalence claimed. Exact guard strength and caption/narrator roles remain open.

common_constructor.operation: DESCRIBE_T(x:T,P:T→Bool)→Description<T> containing referent-domain T and restriction P; not an actual event, evidence token or arbitrary bundled source clause.
common_constructor.consumer: SEEK(person,Description<Place>)→Directive(actor=person,target=that same PlaceDescription). Directive does not assert existence of a found dwelling or successful action.
common_constructor.reused_dependency: The emitted PlaceDescription must be recovered through a genuinely written shared reference construction and passed unchanged to the S seek consumer. A global argument rule and actual constituent reductions must be paid before C0 authorship; no new macro for each group.
common_constructor.rival: Diagnostic account emits PatientDescription/Diagnosis(person,sign/inference) and later predicates the body of that same patient. Treatment account emits proposed action/result for patient.
common_constructor.why_nonrenaming: Place and person are different declared domains, and SEEK reads target-place restriction. It cannot consume diagnosis.patient or diagnose a dwelling merely because both records have a generic owner field. One unified Description<T> operation retains T; no implicit Person→Place conversion or occurrence-specific owner swap.

unequal_consequences: Under unchanged ambient condition and adviser, replacing the desired dwelling by a warm sunny site violates the specified cool/shaded target restriction while leaving an individual body diagnosis unchanged.

Under unchanged target place, changing the patient sign may change a diagnosis but cannot by itself change the sought dwelling descriptor. If a written exception/guard states a different choice, it must be authored globally before use.

SEEK reads Description<Place>; SupportOrDiseasePredication reads Description<Person>. An attempted shared parse that returns the latter to SEEK fails the fixed proposed signature instead of repairing by a hidden role/owner cast.
No instruction→actual-coldness implication: failure to find a dwelling is compatible with the unfulfilled directive.
paid_assumptions: Prospective E/S content allocation and one reader/addressee binder; neither is donated by pictures.
Place/person domains and property applicability; cooling/shade belongs to desired place specification, not observed patient state.
A globally fixed construction for conditional/corrective description and subsequent imperative/reference, including actual written scope and operand boundaries.
One finite part inventory and unchanged same-form functions across both complete blocks; inherited structural hierarchy does not identify their morphemes.
All unconsumed forms/uncertainties remain explicit; unknown lexical atoms, scope/guards and reference exponents are not silently completed.

known_predecessors.change: Already separates constitution, environment and advice. This proposal does not claim that distinction as new. The materially narrower contract is one desired-place output consumed by an explicit SEEK signature over two nominated complete blocks, rather than any unspecified corrective human effect.

known_predecessors.difference: Current diagnostic authoring owns patient/specimen/examiner chain. This is a separate raw source-instruction rival with a PlaceSpec consumer, no active author outputs read and no occurrence-fit hints.

known_predecessors.limit: Whole seasonal captions do not establish main-poem speakers. No speaker change at a paragraph boundary or source caption→target voice transfer.

known_predecessors.difference: General goal/command/report modality is already retained; the change here is a specific source-owned desired location and domain-sensitive consumer, not novelty for commands lacking actuality.

known_predecessors.limit: Old process-to-faculty nominalizer fails IT/RF ar/ar; no free ar sense, idempotence, new higher-order frame or cast repairs it.
Their incomplete full-world supply/quantifier accounts remain unchanged; no old owner assignments or new generic frame object are imported.

design.falsifier: If a prospectively frozen whole E/S derivation returns a Person description where its written S SEEK requires a Place description, loses the emitted target restriction, silently changes the addressee/reference, converts the directive into accomplished bodily coldness, or cannot cover the full blocks under the frozen finite parts, reject this specific C0 construction. Source analogy alone does not discriminate actual text.
